context: M21 o8 (wire branch). Lisle's office in lamplight. The ledger on a photocopier in the hall.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Forty pages. The machine is slow. Every page sounds like a gunshot.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: First page: October seventy-one. C.M. Carl. The night I waited in the car.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Back in the cabinet, exactly. He measures the gaps. Marjorie said so.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Calloway's wire is hot under my shirt. Everybody sweats.
